typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MCAID_COUNTY_CD as string,
		MCAID_COUNTY_DESC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT    PREMIUM_SVC_AREA_CD as MCAID_COUNTY_CD   ,PREMIUM_SVC_AREA_DESC as MCAID_COUNTY_DESC FROM DW.IR_MSTR_PREMIUM_SVC_AREA',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DBCountyODW
DBCountyODW derive(MCAID_COUNTY_CD = MCAID_COUNTY_CD) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		CountyCode as string,
		CountyDesc as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CountyCode = MCAID_COUNTY_CD,
		CountyDesc = MCAID_COUNTY_DESC)) ~> DBCountyE
